create.name: Johanna Burkhardt
create.bio:
Johanna Burkhardt is a channel, medium and energy facilitator from San Diego, California. Her spiritual search began in 2011, when she started asking who she really was beneath the roles she had always played for others, and over the following years she trained in several energy methods, including DNA activation work, before shaping her own approach, which she calls The Purification Process. She has written three books, among them Holy Grail: The Journey Through My Soul's Evolution, which weaves her personal story together with material she describes as channelled.

In her teaching she returns again and again to self-responsibility, firm boundaries and the belief that the answers we look for already live inside us. She works one to one online, in single Quantum Soul Sessions that can mix energy reading, light language, messages from guides and coaching, and in a six-month private mentorship with fortnightly calls. She records meditations and short courses for Insight Timer on manifesting and stepping into a fuller sense of self, and hosts the Cosmic Blonde podcast, where she talks with other intuitives, coaches and healers. Her style is frank, lively and informal.

books.title: Holy Grail: The Journey Through My Soul's Evolution
books.author: Johanna Burkhardt
books.description: A memoir of her spiritual awakening, interleaved with passages she presents as channelled guidance. Its thread is the search for the one key to life, and the discovery that it was never outside her.

courses.title: Quantum Soul Sessions
courses.description: Single 45-minute online sessions shaped around what you bring. Depending on the need they can include energy reading, light language and toning, messages from guides or loved ones, and coaching, and each call is recorded for you. Booking is by email.

courses.title: Private Mentorship
courses.description: A six-month one-to-one programme of twelve hour-long Zoom calls every other week, with messaging support in between and one of her full courses included. The focus is on developing intuitive gifts, building self-awareness and living from a steadier inner sense of self.

courses.title: Recalibrate And Create The Reality You Are Desiring
courses.description: A six-day Insight Timer course of short daily lessons on getting clear about the life you want and practising being the person who already lives it. It closes with a routine to keep up for forty days.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Becoming Your Best Self
courses.description: Four longer masterclasses on Insight Timer, best taken one a week, on inner structure, old patterns that resurface as you change, self-trust and boundaries, and life purpose. Each comes with exercises to practise between sessions.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Johanna Burkhardt on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations, affirmations and transmissions on abundance, returning to the heart and opening to receive. Free to hear in the app or a browser.
